newsitem.title: UK: Novorossiisk loadings running a week late - trader.
newsitem.headline: Novorossiisk loadings running a week late - trader.

text.p: Crude loadings at the Russian Black Sea port of Novorossiisk are running up to a week behind schedule due to bureaucratic and weather-related delays, Mediterranean traders said on Tuesday.
A trader with a Urals cargo due to load Nov 15-17 said he was unable to clarify a loading date due to customs authorisation problems and persistent bad weather.
"It could load as late as (Nov) 22-23," he said. "We haven't got very good information from the port...Only Transneft really knows what's going on."
Another Urals cargo which was slated to load on Nov 10-12 has been put back until Nov 15-17, traders said.
The port closed briefly on Monday due to bad weather but was operating normally on Tuesday with the two main crude berths both occupied, a shipping source said.
